Article 40 on organisation of village panchayats

new.x: Article 40 directs the State to organise village panchayats as units of self-government; the 73rd Amendment put it into effect through Part IX. Articles 39(b), 44 and 48 deal with resources, a common civil code and agriculture/animal husbandry.
new.tq: Art. 40 -> CDP was a step towards it; 73rd Amendment gave it effect.

new.s:
Which of the following are compulsory provisions under Part IX of the Constitution?
1. A Gram Sabha in every village or group of villages
2. A three-tier system (subject to the 20 lakh population exception)
3. A State Election Commission
4. A State Finance Commission every five years
new.x: All four are compulsory under the text of Part IX: Gram Sabha (243A), three tiers (243B), SFC every five years (243I) and SEC (243K). Notes that list the Gram Sabha, three tiers or SEC as voluntary are wrong, so every option that leaves one out is wrong.
new.tq: Voluntary = BC reservation, MP/MLA representation, devolving the 29 subjects, financial powers.
